img.caption: Fig 2: Main results across CLINC150 / MixATIS / MixSNIPS (unified protocol v1.0). Left: Set IoU (Jaccard); right: avg predicted set size on log scale. Hatched bars with italic n/a mark settings not evaluated: CICC (split CP on BERT) was only run on single-intent CLINC150; CLINC150 set-level Jaccard is not defined for single-label conformal baselines. On multi-intent benchmarks CICC/MULACONF trade coverage for huge sets (4.5-150 intents, up to 748 on MixATIS tree variant). QP-OneModel 10-shot emits 4.2-4.9 candidates yet trails Ours. Ours attains the best multi-intent IoU on MixSNIPS (0.757) with tight sets of 1.5-1.8 intents, no task-specific training.
